findings.motion: SB544, Voter identification; identification containing a photograph required (chief patron; introduced 2026-01-14)
findings.note: Bill would require a photo ID to vote and repeal the option to vote after signing a sworn statement; a voter without photo ID would get a provisional ballot, and the Department of Elections would provide free voter photo ID cards. Passed by indefinitely in Privileges and Elections (8-Y 6-N) on 2026-01-27. Bill text on the tracker page; official LIS page https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20261/SB544 could not be read.
subjects: provisional ballot for voter without ID

findings.motion: SJ27 (SJR27), Constitutional amendment (first reference); qualifications of voters; United States citizenship (chief patron; introduced 2026-01-13)
findings.note: Proposed amendment to the Virginia Constitution stating that a person who has not obtained U.S. citizenship at birth or by naturalization is not qualified to vote. Passed by indefinitely in Privileges and Elections (8-Y 6-N) on 2026-01-27.
